# JPEXS canvas helper

FFDec 26.3.0, JPEXS and contributors; LGPL-3.0-or-later. The unminified helper is included here and can be replaced independently of the site. Changes replace two eval calls with named function calls and remove the standalone exporter resize controls. Exported drawings remain attributed to 정기수 교수님 and do not acquire this helper’s license.

[Upstream source](https://github.com/jindrapetrik/jpexs-decompiler/blob/master/libsrc/ffdec_lib/src/com/jpexs/helpers/resource/canvas.js).
